scope: Bulgaria medical discovery — Medical University Sofia

verifiedFacts.claim: Medical University Sofia publishes a 2026/27 foreign-citizen admission route for Medicine, Dentistry and Pharmacy, with translated and legalised foreign-secondary documents required.
The university says admitted foreign students pay the applicable English-specialty tuition in addition to the Bulgarian-nationals paid-form annual fee.
The university announced paid 2026/27 enrolment in Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmacy, Public Health and Health Care in July 2026.

holdReasons: No current 2026/27 official fee amount for the foreign English Medicine cohort was established. The university identifies the components but does not publish their combined amount on the reviewed admission page.

No current programme-specific English-Medicine admissions guide was found that unambiguously supplies the applicable entrance examination, language standard, dates, documents and course delivery for the non-EU cohort.
No independent current programme-accreditation record sufficient for the required recognition badges was captured in this batch.
nextAction: Obtain MU-Sofia's current 2026/27 English Medicine fee decision and foreign-admission guide, then verify programme accreditation through the relevant Bulgarian authority.
